letter.company_line: Hobsons Bay City Council's Drainage and Development team looks after drainage investigations, flood mitigation and development engineering assessments.
letter.subject: Graduate Drainage and Development Engineer
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Drainage and Development Engineer role in your Drainage and Development team. Drainage investigations, assessing engineering plans for development and supporting flood mitigation work in a council close to where I live is the kind of graduate role I have been working towards.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), where I studied hydraulics, surveying and civil design. Stormwater drainage design was a core part of my coursework, and I lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date. That work taught me to check plans against what is built and to raise issues early.

I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton VIC, a short drive from Altona. I have not yet worked in local government, so I would learn your drainage policies, Legal Point of Discharge and Build Over Easement processes quickly and keep clear records.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

screening_answers.a: Not visible before starting the form; answer from the resume and cover letter. Police check: willing to undergo pre-employment checks (locked). Victorian driver's licence: Yes (on record). Start date and salary: Marc to answer.
